script_text: The cosmos is flipping Aries's world upside down this week — and you won't see it coming. Wednesday brings Venus trine Pluto into your 8th House — the energy shifts to deep emotional transformation in love and shared finances. By Thursday, Jupiter enters your 1st House, sparking renewed confidence and a fresh identity shift that carries through the weekend. Wednesday is your power day — Venus trine Pluto activates your 8th House of intimacy and joint resources. Monday is your worst day — Mercury square Neptune creates confusion and miscommunication. Trust your instincts on Wednesday but verify every detail on Monday. Follow for daily updates.
